If the method is free, why pay for the platform?
The method tells you what to do. The platform does it for you: it runs the agents at the same time, has a second AI check their work, keeps
Can I use my Claude subscription?
For the free method, yes: install it in Claude and run it within your plan. The platform connects to your AI provider's developer account in
What does the AI usage cost?
A small part of the total. You see an estimate before anything runs, and you set a cap that the run will not cross.
